source: Marine Regions (marineregions.org) World EEZ v12, MRGID 8480 (Indian Exclusive Economic Zone) and MRGID 8333 (Indian Exclusive Economic Zone, Andaman and Nicobar Islands), fetched via WFS 2026-08-24. Exterior rings simplified (shapely simplify, tolerance 0.05 deg, preserve_topology=True); interior rings (land/shoal exclusions) kept where area >= 0.0005 deg^2 and simplified at tolerance 0.01 deg, then buffer(0)-repaired where simplification introduced a self-intersection. Area distortion of the exterior alone measured at +0.28% (mainland) and -0.01% (Andaman and Nicobar).
